notes.title: Patch 1.1.2
notes.notes:
Fixed several graphic bugs
Item descriptions optimized
Balancing adjusted
Battle Hud optimized
Spelling mistakes corrected
Display errors in dialogs fixed
Sound mixing improved

notes.title: V.1.1.0 New soundtrack, graphics update and winter in the DLC
notes.notes:
With the current update No one lives in heaven has a new soundtrack composed especially for the game.

The first chapter has been completely reworked and improved graphically.

In the realtime menu it is now winter.

The version code is now visible in the start menu. With a click on the code the credits can be retrieved.

notes.title: Various bug fixes
notes.notes:
The current update fixes the following bugs / brings the following improvements:

- errors when closing the Quick Menu were fixed
- in the Pacman mini game the game does not end after the Game Over screen
- the movement routes of various NPCs have been adjusted so that they no longer block the exits
- companion bug in the final fight is fixed
- error in the light setting in the DLC fixed

notes.title: Casino, Miji, Lumberjack, Mini games and Bug fixes
notes.notes:
The new update brings the following improvements:

- the questions and answers for the allowed games in the casino (chapter 1) have been optimized and made more logical
- Spacerace (chapter 2) and Pacman (chapter 6) are now playable several times
- the Miji Quest (chapter 4) is now free of logic errors
- the woodcutter (chapter 4) now ALWAYS gives out the memory boards
- the location of the voice board (chapter 4) is now more clearly formulated
- the Mini-Game in chapter 5 has been replaced by another one
- the brewing of potions in chapter 5 is now sensitive regarding the amount of potions
- the statements of the mayor in chapter 5 are now more logical and mathematically correct
- Skill and equipment values were optimized
- several spelling and grammar errors have been removed

notes.title: Terminals of Death and bug fixes
notes.notes:
Today's update makes the terminals become interactive at death in chapter 4. From now on, interesting information can be read there. In addition, the Perk machine has become more extensive. 

The water delivery quest in chapter 2 is now bug-free.

The clown in chapter 3 is now bug-free, too.

7 more spelling mistakes were removed.

notes.title: Bug fixes and improvements
notes.notes:
The following bugs were fixed with the current update:

- Factory in Chapter 4 now bug free
- Sound mixing of the Outro improved
- Final fixed (fight + music)
- spelling errors in Chapters 5, 6 and the Final fixed
- Weather effects in the spaceship corrected
- Synchronizations in Chapter 5 now bug free
- Companion system improved

notes.title: optional Auto Save and bug fixes
notes.notes:
Today's update makes various spelling mistakes in the digital nirvana disappear as well as the partly too high level of difficulty in the castle in the third chapter. For example, the fire bowls now have a better light cone and as soon as you use the shortcut, it gets bright everywhere.

But the most important thing: In the options you can now activate an Auto Save function. With this you can save at important places in the game. Requirement: you have created at least one manual save point. 

The embarrassing quantity of orthographic mistakes, which were removed in favor of a better reading flow, is about 50.

In addition, considerable performance improvements were made in chapter 1.
